description: Search upcoming travel-worthy events in every What's Up In city at once: where an artist, band, comedian or team is playing, which cities have a festival, conference or expo, big arena shows, games and races. Only events worth a trip are indexed (named performers, festivals, conferences/expos, arena shows, games, races), not every local listing: for everything in one city (small gigs, classes, meetups) use search_events with its city. Give a `query`, at least one of `kinds`, or a place. Each result names its city and links to the original listing (`link`) and the event on that city's site (`on_site`); `searched` says which cities were included and how fresh each is. No sign-in; each client gets 30 calls a minute and 2,500 event rows an hour.

cities.description: Only these cities (names or slugs): Boston, Chicago, Los Angeles, Orange County, Sacramento, San Diego, San Francisco, Seattle, Albuquerque, Almaty, Anchorage, Atlanta, Baltimore, Bangkok, Beijing, Berlin, Buffalo, Cairo, Cancún, Cape Town, Cincinnati, Cleveland, Dallas-Fort Worth, DC, Denver, Detroit, Fresno, Guangzhou, Havana, Honolulu, Houston, Inland Empire, Kansas City, Las Vegas, London, Mexico City, Miami, Minneapolis-St. Paul, Montreal, Nashville, New Orleans, New York, Paris, Philadelphia, Phoenix, Pittsburgh, Portland, Raleigh, Richmond, Rome, Salt Lake City, San Antonio, San Juan, Savannah, Seoul, Shanghai, St. Louis, Sydney, Tokyo, Toronto, Vancouver. Default: all.

kinds.description: Only these kinds: act = named performers; festival = festival; major = major local festival; conference = conference / expo; big_show = arena or amphitheater show; game = sports game (any level); pro_game = professional sports game (MLB, NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, WNBA, NWSL); race = race.

near.description: "lat,lon": only events within radius_km of it, with distance_km. (search_events also takes place names.) Unmapped venues are left out (place.unplaced_events).

neighborhood.description: Only events in this neighborhood or town (whole words, e.g. 'Silver Lake', 'South End', 'Pasadena'). Events whose venue isn't mapped can't be placed and are left out; place.unplaced_events counts them.

query.description: An artist, band, comedian, team, festival or conference name, or words to match in titles/performers/venues, e.g. 'Khruangbin', 'Oktoberfest', 'AI summit'. Optional when `kinds`, `neighborhood` or `near` is given.

trip_only.description: Only events worth a special trip (multi-day festivals, festivals on a city's watchlist, arena/amphitheater shows, multi-day conferences, full-distance races). Default: true when there is no query, false when searching a name.

name: search_across_cities

on_site.description: The event on that city's site

looser_matches.description: Weaker matches left out (the query only in a title or venue)

searched.description: Which cities were searched and how fresh each is

title: Search events across all cities
